title: Create storage cleanup utility for orphaned files
description: Build a new helper that invokes StorageProvider.deleteObject on audioStorageKey and coverImageStorageKey, tolerating missing keys.
acceptanceCriteria: Helper accepts optional audioStorageKey and coverImageStorageKey parameters.
deleteObject is called for each non-null key.
Missing or null keys simply skip deleteObject without errors.

title: Wire cleanup into POST /tracks registration
description: Wrap the track registration endpoint so cleanup runs on any error after uploads succeed.
acceptanceCriteria: Track registration calls cleanup utility when any post-upload error occurs.
Cleanup is invoked before the HTTP error response is returned.

title: Verify cleanup behavior with unit tests
description: Add tests confirming the cleanup utility deletes keys and handles missing keys gracefully.
acceptanceCriteria: Test verifies deleteObject is called for each uploaded key.
Test verifies no error when cleanup receives null keys.
